title: Query probability as a seed average
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet with probability law $\pi$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space. For any coordinate $i$, the probability that $T$ queries $i$, when the input is drawn from the product law with independent coordinates of law $\pi$, equals the seed-law average of the corresponding probability for each deterministic tree selected by the seed.
hypotheses_covered: Randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space and seed law
